setup_masked_lm_task: setup a MaskedLMTask for training BERT or RoBERTa style masked language models
load_masked_lm_dataset: load a masked language model dataset split with token masking and blocking
configure_masked_lm_args: configure masked LM task arguments including mask probability and tokens per sample
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference with token blocking and beginning-of-sentence prepending
review_masked_lm_task: review the MaskedLMTask class and its dataset loading and masking pipeline
